turns.question: How many MQLs did paid social bring in during September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: there is no MQL (marketing-qualified lead) metric and no lead-qualification dimension, so I can't give that figure. The closest metrics are Leads (CRM leads created, on the day they were created) and Bookings (bookings made by leads), both of which can be filtered to the social channel; tell me if one of those is what you want.
